description: An action pinned by digest under a floating major tag such as # v4 is only ever moved to an exact release such as # v4.3.1; no update keeps the floating value. A floating tag moves upstream while the pinned digest stays, so a comment that keeps it goes stale, which jactionlint reports as a version comment that no longer matches the pin. The default preset's helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver makes version updates write exact releases, and its rule disabling digest updates under a floating value stops a digest refresh from keeping # v4.
